version.body: 交付、可观察获取、agent 采用声明、检查结果必须分开记录，并绑定确切知识版本与证据；缺失获取记录时不得宣称已观察到获取，缺失检查记录时不得宣称已检查或检查通过。交付或获取不证明理解或采用，agent 声明不证明合规；检查通过仅支持其明确覆盖的检查结论。
version.rationale: Narrow correction after actual replacement-executor use: v1 combines missing acquisition and missing check into one prohibition about read/understood/compliant, without explicitly stating that even present records do not prove understanding or compliance. Separate the missing-record claims and bound positive check claims to actual coverage, following the existing normative trace-and-guarantee boundaries. Preserve selector, constraint authority, work commitments and historical v1.

sources.content: Distinguish what Keepsail supplied, what observed retrieval/read operations returned, what the agent stated it adopted/rejected/challenged and why, and what result checks verified. Record identity, version and provenance within the observable integration boundary and disclose missing observations.
Supply or reading does not prove understanding or adoption; agent statements do not prove compliance.
